Answer: E
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 5) demonstrates an enlarged cardiac silhouette consistent with cardiomegaly and a focal opacity in the right mid-lung zone containing surgical clips, which corresponds to the pseudoaneurysm seen on the coronal CT (Figure 1). This combination supports the diagnosis of an iatrogenic pulmonary artery pseudoaneurysm (likely post-surgical given the clips) with associated cardiac enlargement.
